lines.text: Argentina work the ball out from their own area.
France squeeze high, forcing that ball over the touchline.
Theo Hernández takes the throw into the left channel.
Argentina crowd it out inside the area.
That intervention flips possession into open midfield.
Argentina send it diagonally infield.
Driven forward to the near side.
Argentina race into open space.
Squared across!
Goal! Struck in from the left, past the goalkeeper!
End to end, finished first time.
France, ranked fourth entering the final, undone on the counter.
Barcelona have the ball on the right, well outside the penalty area.
Betis had lost only one of their previous eleven, all competitions.
A Betis defender challenges the carrier out on the right.
Koundé combines on the right.
Into the area.
Cut across goal.
Goal! Ferran Torres finishes from close range, the ball in the net.
Struck in front of a sprawling goalkeeper.
Barcelona came from behind to win their previous two La Liga matches 3-1.
